name: Hill Goliath

traits.name: Hill's Tumble
traits.description: When you hit a Large or smaller creature with an attack roll and deal damage to it, you can knock that creature Prone. No additional saving throw is specified. You can do so a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus per Long Rest.

reviewNotes: SRD 5.2.1 Giant Ancestry adapted into one selectable Subspecies, not six independent options granted to every Goliath.
Inherits Powerful Build, Large Form, size and Speed from species.goliath; the chosen ancestry boon uses Proficiency Bonus activations per Long Rest.
Applies the Dorks & Dice native Prone condition; monitor comparative balance with other ancestries during the first playtest.
Bigby's rune, feat and cultural traditions are not automatically inherited or assigned as an Upbringing.
